How this works. The page body is AES-256-GCM ciphertext; the key is derived from the code with PBKDF2-SHA256 (1,200,000 iterations). Nothing is sent anywhere — the whole thing runs in this browser. A short numeric code is a speed bump, not real confidentiality: anyone who downloads this file can try codes offline.
